task_title: Adapter --check verdict vocabulary: a WARN row can never print PASS
task_criteria: No harness adapter may print PASS beside its own WARN rows. Graded at the committed tree: (a) a PATH-local stub opencode that answers --version and advertises no run/exec/serve mode, run as `bash scripts/harness/install-opencode.sh --check` with PATH/HOME pointed at the stub, prints its two WARN rows then a verdict line `OPENCODE: UNVERIFIED` (never PASS) and exits with the status specs/HARNESS.md defines for UNVERIFIED; (b) every shipped adapter (install-opencode.sh, install-hermes.sh, install-claude-code.sh, install-codex.sh, install-pi-agent.sh, install-deepseek.sh) ends with a verdict line drawn from the fixed vocabulary PASS | UNVERIFIED | FAIL (n) decided by row counts, not by the FAIL counter alone; (c) `bash tests/selftest.sh` exits 0 printing SELFTEST: PASS and carries new named PASS rows proving three arms against one fixture: WARN-only stub -> UNVERIFIED (never PASS), FAIL stub -> FAIL (n) and nonzero exit, all-PASS stub -> PASS and 0 exit; (d) `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints RESULT: OK; (e) specs/HARNESS.md states the vocabulary and the UNVERIFIED exit status, and docs/handbook/chapters/M5-harness.md sections 6/7 describe the verdict contract; (f) the commit carries a ch:trace marker naming row CF-141, chapter M5 S2 and the new selftest section. The board row CF-141 is LEFT PENDING for the foreman to close; do not edit .coding-hermes/board/.
